title: Tree (DRAFT)
description: A durable identity for one tree. Things that change over time are observations, not fields here (TREE-002). DRAFT — not approved.

physicalTag.description: Tag or plate fixed to the tree, if any. Not a key — tags fall off and are re-used. See open question 2.

species.description: OPEN QUESTION 1: which taxonomy is authoritative. Only the vernacular name is required, so field capture is never blocked by a caretaker not knowing a Latin binomial.

location.description: Exact position as captured. Never served at this precision without tree.read_precise_location.

locationPrecisionPolicy.description: TREE-003. Governs what a caller without the precise-location permission receives. OPEN QUESTION 3: the default should probably not be 'exact'.

caretakerPartyId.description: The party who tends this tree — a land role of 'farmer' on the parcel, per the parties proposal.

status.description: A tree that has fallen is never deleted; its history and any sponsorship it carried must remain answerable (TREE-001).

sponsorable.description: Whether this tree may be offered for sponsorship. Must be false unless the parcel's boundary is approved — see open question 6. Enforcement belongs in the sponsorship contract.
